subject.title: feat(signal): add chat-based setup and account linking

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this chat-based Signal linking flow and its shared QR/cancellation session contract as the supported product direction, with this PR replacing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100906?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately broader than a Signal-only repair: it adds a Gateway chat capability, client rendering behavior, and shared hosted-wizard ownership semantics. Choosing whether that cross-client surface is the desired long-term setup model requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor this canonical direction
options.body: Keep this PR as the replacement for the older branch, require an exact-head rebase and compatibility proof, then proceed through normal maintainer review.

options.title: Request a stacked landing plan
options.body: Split the shared Gateway/wizard contract from the Signal plugin flow if maintainers want independently reviewable ownership and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Keep terminal setup as the supported path
options.body: Decline the shared chat-setup expansion and retain Signal linking through the existing terminal-oriented workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this canonical direction
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the replacement for the older branch, require an exact-head rebase and compatibility proof, then proceed through normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The current and related Signal setup branches establish the clearest available continuity for explaining the intended feature boundary to a sponsoring maintainer.
